body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

⚠️ **Seat stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/qa.md` and the `checklist-test` skill §4–§6 (⛔ not copied here), as amended by the ruling on #34632 until the skills lane lands its text. This is **`qa` seat 1**, held together with `eval#1` (#33468) as the **verification seat** (#34632 D6-A: one seat, two charters).

## Current PM — 🟢 os-justin

- **Seated:** `os-justin` · `session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh` · 2026-11-17T09:25Z, on the maintainer's summons in this session (「验证席」, then 「按照最新的裁决 34632，你同时负责 qa eval」). Successor-of: `zhuangjianguo` · `session_01QsR2jUARzLeR7GhKms8a5s` (clocked out 2026-11-15, brief 6891977745).
- **Patrol:** `trig_016zQTotaCLstXdxgNsg7NW2` (daily 13:37 UTC, bound to this session; it checks the D2 signals and the D3 baseline, and is a no-op when nothing is due).
- **Mailbox:** none. Opening one needs a push of the mailbox branch, which this session's permission check refused; knock on the seat post meanwhile (an issue comment wakes nothing, so a knock is read at the next patrol).
- Posture and ledger live in the seat's session; this stub keeps what other accounts read.

## Standing orders

- **Ruling #34632** (comment 6943105103, 「全部 A，D4 加每日上限」):
  - D2-A: this seat starts a round itself on three signals: a new release tag (smoke), every child of an un-paused epic closed (milestone acceptance), and a weekly routine round. The maintainer can still call extra rounds.
  - D6-A: eval and QA are one verification seat; the charters stay separate files.
  - It supersedes the earlier cadence order 「维持"每波开发完你通知"」 (comment 6730062573).
- Still standing (quoted in the comments below): the scenario half of each routine round (the `starter` cards, `--modes scratch --packages workspace`); 「可以开云卡」.
- 「qa#1 继续按口令跑例行轮，qa#2 执行发版波次」: release waves stay with `qa#2` while that seat is held. It is vacant now, so this seat takes the post-release smoke under D2.

## Hand-over ledger

- The previous body revision (2026-11-15) holds the round-1 ledger: the owed list, three uncarded runner observations, and the advisory waiting on a collaborator. Each is re-read in this seat's first round.
- Inherited record still open: #32135 (qa#1 · os-bob, 2026-11-10). Its close-out comments are already done, so it closes in this round.

## Hot-file serial queue

- None: this seat writes no code and opens no PR.

## Notes

- Write path: the relay (`issue-create.mjs`, `post-stamped.mjs`, `close-cards.mjs`, `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`). ⛔ No GitHub MCP writes.
- Runner lessons (round 1): one cloud session per 16–23 checklist items; `source_revision` refuses a short sha; a scenario runner in Accept-edits mode waits on a permission prompt for every `send_message`; a `qa-run` record lists every item on its own line, id first.
